description_en: Queries the data backup cycle, backup time, backup retention period, and automatic recovery point configurations of a specified Supabase instance
description_zh: 查询指定 Supabase 实例的数据备份周期、备份时间、备份保留天数及自动恢复点配置
name: DescribeSupabaseBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html operation to query available region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html接口查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the Supabase instance. You can obtain instance ID from the Supabase page in the console
parameters.help_zh: Supabase实例ID，可以在控制台Supabase页面获取
parameters.name: project_id

BackupInterval.description_en: The interval between automatic recovery points, in minutes. A value greater than 0 indicates that automatic recovery points are enabled. If the feature is disabled, -1 is returned
BackupInterval.description_zh: 自动恢复点的间隔，单位：分钟。大于 0 表示开启自动恢复点；关闭时返回 -1

BackupRetentionPeriod.description_en: The data backup retention period, in days
BackupRetentionPeriod.description_zh: 数据备份保留天数，单位：天

EnableRecoveryPoint.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic recovery points are enabled. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
EnableRecoveryPoint.description_zh: 是否开启自动恢复点。true：开启；false：关闭

PreferredBackupPeriod.description_en: The data backup cycle. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Valid values: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday
PreferredBackupPeriod.description_zh: 数据备份周期。多个取值用英文逗号（,）分隔。取值：Monday（周一）、Tuesday（周二）、Wednesday（周三）、Thursday（周四）、Friday（周五）、Saturday（周六）、Sunday（周日）

PreferredBackupTime.description_en: The data backup time window in UTC. The format is HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ
PreferredBackupTime.description_zh: 数据备份时间窗口，使用 UTC 时间，格式为 HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ

RecoveryPointPeriod.description_en: The interval for the automatic creation of recovery points, in hours. Valid values: 1/6 (10 minutes), 1/2 (30 minutes), 1, 2, 4, and 8. This value is valid only when EnableRecoveryPoint is set to true. If automatic recovery points are shutdown, 0 is returned
RecoveryPointPeriod.description_zh: 自动创建恢复点的间隔，单位：小时。取值：1/6（10 分钟）、1/2（30 分钟）、1、2、4、8。仅在 EnableRecoveryPoint 为 true 时表示有效的自动恢复点间隔。关闭自动恢复点时返回 0
